element.name: TGridPrinterAction
element.short: Standard-Action which links to a GridPrinter and calls its Print method to print a grid

element.name: TGridPrinterAction.Notification
element.short: Inherited procedure which sets the internal FGridPrinter variable to nil when the GridPrinter is deleted.

element.name: TGridPrinterAction.ExecuteTarget
element.short: Executes the Print() method of the associated TGridPrinter instance if that matches with the Target parameter.

element.name: TGridPrinterAction.HandlesTarget
element.short: Returns true when the parameter Target is the associated GridPrinter

element.name: TGridPrinterAction.UpdateTarget
element.short: Disables the action if no GridPrinter is associated with the action or if the grid associated with the GridPrinter is not visible.

element.name: TGridPrinterAction.GridPrinter
element.short: Points to the TGridPrinter instance which is associated with the action.

element.name: TGridPrintPreviewAction
element.short: Standard-Action which links to a GridPrintPreviewDialog and calls its Execute method to display a preview a grid to be printed by a GridPrinter.

element.name: TGridPrintPreviewAction.Notification
element.short: Inherited procedure which sets the internal FPreviewDlg variable to nil when the associated PrintPreviewDialog is deleted.

element.name: TGridPrintPreviewAction.ExecuteTarget
element.short: Runs the Execute() method of the associated TGridPrintPreviewDialog instance if that matches with the Target parameter.

element.name: TGridPrintPreviewAction.HandlesTarget
element.short: Returns true when the parameter Target is the associated GridPrintPreviewDialog

element.name: TGridPrintPreviewAction.UpdateTarget
element.short: Disables the action if no PreviewDialog is associated with the action or if that is not associated with a GridPrinterassigned to a visible grid.

element.name: TGridPrinterAction.FGridPrinter
element.short: Internal variable for the associated TGridPrinter instance.

element.name: TGridPrintPreviewAction.FPreviewDlg
element.short: Internal variable for the associated TGridPrintPreviewDialog instance.

element.name: TGridPrintPreviewAction.PreviewDialog
element.short: Points to the TGridPrintPreviewDialog instance which is associated with the action.
